_readme: Business facts. status: confirmed = supplied by the client (logo and address, via Samson); sample = written for the design sample and must be confirmed or replaced before launch (the launch gate blocks any 'sample' value); not-offered = the business does not do this, so hide it. Text can use {{tokens}}: {{phone}} {{email}} {{address}} {{city}} {{hours}} {{estimates}} {{payment}} {{appointments}} {{emergency}} {{serviceArea}} {{serviceModel}} {{insurance}} {{warranty}}.

businessName.label: Business name
businessName.source: Client logo supplied by Samson on 2026-10-16.
businessName.ask: Exact legal and trading name as it should appear in the footer and contracts.

tagline.label: Tagline
tagline.value: We are here to make a difference!

tradeLine.label: Trade
tradeLine.ask: Keep wording, or add heavy-duty / diesel / fleet?

location.label: City
location.source: City from the address supplied by Samson on 2026-10-16.

address.label: Street address
address.source: Supplied by Samson on 2026-10-16. Oakland Avenue in Garland 75041 exists in OpenStreetMap; no public listing for the business was found.
address.ask: Confirm it is the shop, plus truck access and parking.

phone.label: Phone number
phone.source: Supplied by Samson on 2026-10-17. Still to ask Teddy: whether it takes texts and whether roadside calls use a separate line.
phone.ask: Main phone, whether it takes texts, and whether roadside calls use a separate line.

email.label: Email address
email.source: Invented. The domain was checked and is unregistered, so no stranger receives mail sent to it.

emergency.label: Roadside availability
emergency.value: Call any time. Roadside calls are answered day and night.
emergency.ask: Is roadside help available 24/7, or set hours? Is there a separate roadside number? What does it cover (tires, jump-starts, fuel, minor repairs, towing)?

serviceArea.label: Service area
serviceArea.value: Garland and the greater Dallas–Fort Worth area
serviceArea.ask: Cities and highways covered for shop visits and for roadside calls; any distance limit.

serviceModel.label: How service works
serviceModel.value: Full-service shop in Garland, plus mobile roadside service across the area
serviceModel.source: Invented for the sample. The logo only confirms roadside assistance.
serviceModel.ask: Shop only, mobile only, or both? Is there a yard for trailers?

appointments.label: Appointment policy
appointments.value: Walk-ins are welcome. Appointments are recommended for inspections and maintenance.

estimates.label: Estimate process
estimates.value: You get a clear estimate and we get your approval before any work begins.
estimates.ask: How estimates and approvals work; any diagnostic fee. Do not publish prices unless Teddy asks to.

payment.label: Payment methods
payment.value: Major credit and debit cards, cash, and fleet cards
payment.ask: Exact payment methods, which fleet or fuel cards, and whether net terms exist for approved accounts.

insurance.label: Insurance
insurance.ask: Whether to mention insurance at all, and the exact wording Teddy approves.

warranty.label: Warranty
warranty.value: Ask us about warranty coverage on parts and labor
warranty.ask: Any written warranty on parts or labor, and its exact terms.

domain.label: Domain and hosting
domain.ask: Existing domain, who controls DNS, and who signs off on going live.

hours.label: Business hours
hours.ask: Opening hours by day, holiday closures, and whether roadside differs from shop hours.
